scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm test && npm run lint:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
